prompt: Select the group's total lag: the sum of (log_end_offset - committed_offset), aliased total_lag.
template:
-- EXPECTED: [["billing", 60], ["zeta", 60], ["fraud", 50], ["analytics", 40]]

-- Tables are loaded for you: partitions(topic, partition_id, log_end_offset) and commits(group_id, topic, partition_id, committed_offset).
SELECT c.group_id,
       @@BLANK@@
FROM commits c
JOIN partitions p ON p.topic = c.topic AND p.partition_id = c.partition_id
GROUP BY c.group_id
HAVING SUM(p.log_end_offset - c.committed_offset) > 0
ORDER BY total_lag DESC, c.group_id ASC
;
why: SUM aggregates the per-partition lag, and the expression subtracts the committed offset from the log end offset. AS total_lag names the column.
